headline: Nvidia Restricts Advanced AI Chip Sales to Neoclouds Serving Chinese Clients
summary: Nvidia sales representatives informed neocloud customers that they cannot purchase advanced artificial intelligence chips if they rent computing power to Chinese clients.
why: Nvidia is the dominant supplier of specialized processors used for artificial intelligence workloads, and export compliance dictates global deployment of its hardware.

impacts.name: NVIDIA Corp
impacts.why: Restrictions on cloud rental customers limit certain channels for advanced AI chip deployments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Tightening delivery conditions for high-end AI chips impact cloud computing partners servicing restricted jurisdictions.
